name: How long does a typical Law Firm AI Audit take?
description: The duration of an AI audit depends on the firm's size and AI complexity, ranging from weeks for smaller firms to several months for larger ones.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical Law Firm AI Audit take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a Law Firm AI Audit varies based on the firm's size, the complexity of its AI infrastructure, and the specific audit objectives. A smaller firm with fewer AI tools might complete an audit in a few weeks, while larger firms with extensive AI integration could require several months. We provide an estimated timeline following an initial assessment of your firm's unique requirements.
